decisions.finding: Degree-or-equivalent-experience is one alternative; a separate eight-year experience requirement remains a separate constraint. Search-result navigation and other job titles are present, so whole-document keyword counts are unsafe as applicant requirements.
Mentoring junior engineers refers to others. Required and preferred requirement sections are separate. Employer product AI description is not a stated AI requirement for this applicant.
Visible text distinguishes developing solutions using LLMs from developing LLMs. Only partial source viewed; qualification part not adjudicated.
What You Will Need and What Would Be Nice to Have establish separate candidate strengths; years attached to alternative solution/domain wording must not become unrestricted total experience.

Leading/mentoring engineers is a worker duty. Professional-development boilerplate mentioning entry-level employees does not target this vacancy to entry-level applicants. Degree substitution does not waive a separate eight-plus-year requirement.

implementation: New immutable relation_overlay.py over frozen v1.2 evidence; keep baseline unchanged. Report recognized headings as candidates, not exhaustive segmentation. General-plus-preferred clauses remain unresolved unless independently adjudicated. Zero API calls.
production_limit: Overlay is a bounded reusable framework, not proof all semantic variables can be accurately filled by code. Unresolved/unsupported cases retained; code only counts candidates with source evidence.
next_execution: Static QA and cloud-only synthetic/dev120 smoke run; production of accepted fields after a single root acceptance. Do not launch repetitive parser-development cycles or silently lower variable definitions.
